selected.why: It addresses the strongest friction point in the app: the mandatory sign-up to comment. Unlocking one 'Guest Comment' via an ad solves a moment-of-need problem [TAX-3].

Ad-free sessions are the proven analog for media apps like Spotify and Pandora [EX-MUSIC]. Using it as a fallback on the account sidebar targets users already seeking to change their experience [TAX-2].
A proactive hub for 'Daily Reader Streaks' builds a retention loop in a no-scarcity environment, rewarding users with a new cosmetic or utility currency for their attention [TAX-9].

proposals.title: AOL Guest Commenter
proposals.oneLiner: Allow users to post a single news comment by playing a mini-game instead of signing up.

newMechanic.name: Guest Posting
newMechanic.description: A temporary authorization to submit one comment to a news article discussion without a full AOL account registration. Guest comments are processed via AOL's automated safety filters to prevent spam [SAFE-1].
newMechanic.whyNeeded: The sign-up wall on the Add Comment Page (s05) prevents spontaneous interaction from guest users. Providing an ad-supported path monetizes high-intent non-signed-in users.

proposals.trigger: After entering text on the Add Comment Page when the sign-up modal appears.
proposals.eligibility: Non-signed-in users who have entered text in the comment box on the Add Comment Page.

offer.title: Post as a guest
offer.body: Don't want to sign up right now? Play a quick 15-second game to post this comment as a guest.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: The guest pass is limited to a single comment per day and does not grant account benefits like comment history, replies, or profile customization. A sign-in contrast line reminds users that a full AOL account is required for permanent features [CANN-4].
risks: Potential for lower-quality comments from non-verified users
Increased moderation load if automated filters fail

proposals.title: AOL Ad-Free Sprint
proposals.oneLiner: Enjoy 15 minutes of ad-free news reading after a quick game.

economy: AD TODAY native on Home News Feed (e42)
AD TODAY banner on Article Ad View (e17)

newMechanic.name: Ad-free Sprint
newMechanic.description: A time-boxed entitlement managed via a remote config flag (isAdFree) that toggles the global state, disabling native Taboola ad rendering units (e47, e48, e49, e50) across s02 and s03.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: The app is currently high-density in advertisements but lacks a scarcity-based value exchange to drive engagement or sample premium benefits.

proposals.trigger: User identifies a native ad unit in the Home News Feed (s02) and taps the 'Ad-Free Sprint' call-to-action.
proposals.eligibility: Non-paying users currently exposed to standard ad density.

offer.title: Go Ad-Free for 15 Minutes
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to clear all ads from your news feed for a short sprint.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is strictly time-boxed to 15 minutes, serving as a 'taste of premium' sampling effect rather than a permanent replacement for ad-free tiers. Enforcement toggles ad rendering units via remote config.
risks: Users may grow accustomed to ad-free reading and find the return to standard density jarring.
Potential revenue dip if sprint sessions overlap with peak reading times.

newElements.change: A menu item with a lightning icon titled 'Ad-Free Sprint (15 min)' and a 'Play to Start' subtitle.
A small countdown timer badge next to the 'Home' title indicating remaining ad-free time.
A call-to-action button: 'Play game for 15m ad-free reading'.

proposals.title: Daily Reader Streak & Ad-Free Access
proposals.oneLiner: Earn News Credits daily via streaks to unlock 15-minute ad-free news reading sessions.

economy: AD TODAY native on Home News Feed (e42)

newMechanic.name: AOL News Credits & Ad-Free Mode
newMechanic.description: A habit-building virtual currency earned through daily streaks and rewarded ads. Credits are redeemed in the Article Details view to unlock a 15-minute Ad-Free Reader Mode.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: AOL currently has no scarcity; News Credits and time-boxed Ad-Free sessions create a value exchange to monetize non-paying attention via opt-in rewarded ads.

proposals.trigger: Users interact with the Daily Streak card in the Account Sidebar (s11) to earn credits, or tap 'Go Ad-Free' in Article Details (s03) to redeem credits for ad-free reading.
proposals.eligibility: Non-signed-in users and signed-in non-subscribers who have not claimed today's reward.

offer.title: Earn News Credits
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with AOL to earn 10 News Credits, or unlock 15m of Ad-Free reading!

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is a small, time-boxed sample of ad-free reading (15m) that provides a 'taste' of premium value, encouraging upgrade intent without giving away unlimited ad-free access. Offers are gated to non-subscribers.
risks: Users may find the redemption utility insufficient if not clearly communicated.
Potential fatigue if the streak mechanic is perceived as mandatory.

newElements.change: Add a 'Daily Reader Streak' section with a progress bar and 'Claim Credits' button.
Add 'Go Ad-Free' button that triggers Ad-Free Mode if credits balance allows, or offers a rewarded ad to earn more credits.
